name: goodvibes-jev
description: The goodvibes platform with Jev judgment built in: the judgment foundation, the engine, and the daemon, TUI, agent and web UI products.

scripts.refresh:docs: bun run refresh:contracts && bun run docs:generate
scripts.api:extract: bunx api-extractor run --local --config packages/engine/api-extractor.json && bunx api-extractor run --local --config packages/engine/api-extractor.embed.json && bunx api-extractor run --local --config packages/engine/api-extractor.terminal-shell.json && bun packages/engine/scripts/normalize-api-eol.ts
scripts.test: bun run test:judgment && bun packages/engine/scripts/test.ts && bun run products:test
scripts.api:check: bun run api:extract && git diff --exit-code -- packages/engine/etc/goodvibes-sdk.api.md packages/engine/etc/goodvibes-sdk-embed.api.md packages/engine/etc/goodvibes-terminal-shell.api.md && bun run api:subpath:check
scripts.validate:strict: bun run validate && bun run types:check && bun run contracts:check
scripts.release:verify: bun run validate && bun run flags:graduation && bun run security:audit && bun run test && bun run test:rn && bun run test:workers && bun run test:workers:wrangler && bun run release:dry-run && bun run install:smoke

patchedDependenciesRationale.eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y@6.10.2: Adapt two legacy default imports to the named minimatch function while preserving the patched minimatch 10.x override and all accessibility rules. Bun 1.3.14 does not support scoped overrides; remove this patch when the plugin supports minimatch 10.x.

overridesRationale.sharp: Require 0.35.5 or later in the 0.35.x line to close GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w (librsvg CVE-2026-96889). The prebuilt sharp-libvips 1.3.4 artifacts include patched librsvg 2.63.2. Miniflare 4.20260430.0, used directly and by Wrangler 4.87.0, still requests vulnerable sharp ^0.34.5; remove this override when the dependency graph requires a patched release.
overridesRationale.bash-language-server: Vendored to keep shell language support while preserving a clean high-severity audit surface for the bundled Bash LSP dependency graph.
overridesRationale.fast-xml-parser: Pinned to the audited 5.x parser release used by transitive Google/Cloud tooling.
overridesRationale.fast-uri: Pinned to 3.1.2 to avoid GHSA-v39h-62p7-jpjc in AJV consumers used by release tooling.
overridesRationale.google-auth-library: Pinned to an audited release for Cloudflare/Wrangler transitive auth tooling.
overridesRationale.minimatch: Pinned to a patched glob matcher across build and release transitive dependencies.
overridesRationale.esbuild: Pinned to 0.28.1 to close GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr (missing binary integrity verification in Deno module, enabling RCE via NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY). Wrangler 4.x pins esbuild <0.28.1; this override forces the patched release across all transitive consumers.
overridesRationale.form-data: Pinned to 4.0.6 to close GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx (CRLF injection via unescaped multipart field/file names). Forces the patched release across remaining transitive consumers.
overridesRationale.ws: Pinned to 8.21.0 to close GHSA-96hv-2xvq-fx4p (memory-exhaustion DoS from tiny fragments). Minor bump within the 8.x line forced across miniflare, node-edge-tts, and the openai ws peer.
overridesRationale.undici: Pinned to 7.28.0 to close GHSA-vmh5-mc38-953g, GHSA-vxpw-j846-p89q, and GHSA-hm92-r4w5-c3mj (TLS bypass, WebSocket DoS, SOCKS5 routing). Kept on the 7.x line that jsdom (^7.25.0) and miniflare require; 8.x would be a breaking major.
